blockers.description: compass_dryrun.py fails at G4 fact-gate with false '출처 미매칭' tokens (e.g. '역량을', '바탕으로', '추진하고', '있습니다', '행사를'). Root cause: fact_gate.py noun regex [가-힣]{2,8} grabs noun+particle combos that never appear verbatim in the source body.
blockers.workaround: --skip-g4 flag exists on the dry-run script

decisions.decision: Strip trailing particles/descriptive suffixes from noun chunks before matching
decisions.rationale: The noun regex greedily captures noun+particle combos (행사+를, 준공+할, 그룹+의) that never appear verbatim in the source body, producing false '출처 미매칭' blocks. Stripping the suffix lets the bare noun stem match.

decisions.decision: Render intro_style prompt block from INTRO_STYLE_EXAMPLES + INTRO_STYLE_PREFIXES dicts
decisions.rationale: Keeps prompt text in sync with the example data; avoids dead/hardcoded data (REQ-39-10).
